items.t: Two clusters: Garrison Crossing/Campus around Market Way, Campus Drive and Chehalis Drive, and the Thomas Road–Promontory Road corner below Promontory.
Both are inside Sardis, Schedule B5 of the 2050 Official Community Plan (OCP), south of Highway 1 and the Vedder River.
An older cluster sits on Stevenson Road: Park Place I, 45769 Stevenson Road, and Park Place II, 45753 Stevenson Road, per a City council agenda.
Andmar, 46185 Thomas Road: the developer's statement describes 6 mixed-use and 4 residential buildings, about 120,000 square feet of commercial space, 461 units.
Andmar sits on ten acres of Crown land held in reserve for the Tzeachten First Nation, leased 109 years to May 31, 2128 — its condos are leasehold, not freehold strata.
York Residences, 45511, 45505 and 45497 Campus Drive: three buildings run as rentals by Diverse, not sold strata.
Elim Village Garrison Crossing, 45412 Chehalis Drive: retirement community; buildings named The Redwood, Sequoia, Douglas, Maple and Hawthorn.

blocks.text: Sardis Condos: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Andmar buyers take subleases under the 109-year head lease ending May 31, 2128, so title, mortgage and resale differ from freehold strata.
Garrison apartments sit in CD-9, where apartments meet R5 standards: minimum lot 1,000 square metres, width 30 metres.

blocks.text: Sardis Condos: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Cheam Leisure Centre, 45501 Market Way, is inside the Garrison cluster.
Route 51's terminus is the University of the Fraser Valley campus at Canada Education Park, beside Garrison Campus.
Sardis Park's pond and 655-metre loop, 6898 School Lane, sit beside the Stevenson Road buildings.
Andmar 1 and 2 include a Nature's Fare market, per the developer's building pages.
Cottonwood Centre, 45585 Luckakuck Way, is the larger Sardis-side centre (City permit record).

blocks.text: Sardis Condos: development and new projects

items.t: Andmar, 46185 Thomas Road: condos by Andmar Development Corp. on leased Tzeachten land; about 461 units in 6 mixed-use and 4 residential buildings, per the developer's May 30, 2026 statement. Status: Andmar 1 and 2 complete and move-in ready; Andmar 3 shown for Fall 2026 (as of November 3, 2026).
York Residences, 45511/45505/45497 Campus Drive: three rental buildings by Diverse. Status: completed, operating as rentals (as of November 3, 2026).
Sardis Secondary addition: see sardis-houses-for-sale.
City-wide 2026 rates apply to freehold Sardis strata such as Park Place: see chilliwack-houses-for-sale.
Andmar exception: reserve land is not a Speculation and Vacancy Tax area, and City property tax does not apply.
Route 51 Vedder runs on Vedder Road past Garrison, Downtown Chilliwack to the University of the Fraser Valley campus.
Route 54 Promontory runs via Stevenson, Tyson and Watson Roads up Promontory Road.

blocks.text: Sardis Condos: risks and due diligence

items.t: At Andmar, read the statement and sublease first: the head lease ends May 31, 2128, and the statement says no disclosure statement filing is required.
For strata condos, check the Vedder fan permit area, Bylaw No. 4519 and the depreciation report.

faq.a: No. The developer's statement states the project sits on Crown land held in reserve for the Tzeachten First Nation, leased to Andmar Development Corp. for 109 years ending May 31, 2128; buyers take subleases, so the statement and sublease need review before purchase.

York Residences, 45511, 45505 and 45497 Campus Drive are rental buildings. Diverse lists York A, B and C as rental homes in Garrison Campus, pets not allowed. Buying in Garrison Crossing means a strata building elsewhere, or Elim Village on Chehalis Drive.
faq.q: Can I buy a Campus Drive condo?

faq.a: Because it is operator-run, not standard strata, purchase and monthly charges come from the operator's own documents, not a Form B.
faq.q: What is the retirement option in Sardis?

faq.a: Catchments are address-based, and Sardis splits. The locator for 45501 Market Way returned Watson Elementary, a Mount Slesse or Vedder Middle choice, then G.W. Graham or Sardis Secondary. For Thomas Road: 46200 Stoneview Drive returned Promontory Heights Elementary and G.W. Graham Secondary.
